attempts.response_text:
**To:** Support; Bettina Kroll  
**Subject:** Re: missed barge slot notifications  
**Date:** Aug 27th

Looping in Support + Bettina. Driftmoor Marine Freight escalated yesterday, Aug 26th. Barge slot notifications not sent. Dispatch had the bookings in Pemberline Dock, but nobody on the evening crew got the notices they use to line up trucks for the ramp.

Need someone on the delivery trail this morning, pls. Not just whether the booking saved.

Three examples in the attached dispatch export: slots at 17:20, 18:00 and 18:40, all against the south ramp. Dispatch says the recipient list was unchanged from Monday. They checked junk folders while we were on the phone. Nothing there either. One driver was already waiting by the weighbridge when the ramp clerk found the revised slot on screen.

I've asked them to leave the affected bookings alone for now. No deleting/recreating to see if that wakes it up. They have screenshots of the slot history and can send the original export rather than another cropped picture.

Support — can you pull notification creation, queue and delivery events for those three bookings? Also check whether the slot-change action is being recorded separately from the send. Ticket PS-4826 has the booking refs; putting them there rather than scattering them across this thread.

Bettina — can you join the callback after we have that first pass? They want an explanation before this evening's loading window. I've said we're looking, not that we've found the cause.

For today dispatch is phoning the ramp clerk after each change. Clunky, but at least someone is reading it back. Need to know if other notification types are affected before telling them that workaround covers everything.

Will chase the export now. Sorry, typing between calls — the screenshot attachment didnt come through first time.

— Forwarded message —

**From:** Bettina Kroll  
**To:** Kwame Adjei-Rowe  
**Date:** Aug 26th  
**Subject:** Re: missed barge slot notifications

Support should see this tonight, even if the log pull happens tomorrow.

Kwame's port account needs a named person on the investigation before the next loading window. Can you send the booking refs and the last time dispatch definitely received a notice?

Also ask whether these were new slots or changes to existing ones. That distinction may save a round trip. I'll keep an eye on the thread in the morning.
